name: Spicy Vietnamese-Style Rice Bowl with Tofu, Peas, Radish & Cashews

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes and divide between two small bowls.
Peel and mince shallots. Add one of the bowls with lime juice along with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, add soy sauce, additional fish sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, sugar, and cornstarch to the other bowl with the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp water
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Crumble tofu into large pieces with your fingers and add to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, thinly slice snap peas crosswise. Place on a large plate.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the plate with the snap peas.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate.
When the tofu is golden brown, reduce heat to medium, add sauce to the skillet, and gently stir to coat. Cook until sauce thickens slightly and coats tofu, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and large dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Roughly chop cashews and add to the plate.
To serve, divide rice between bowls; top with tofu, snap peas, radish, avocado, mint, and cashews. Drizzle with dressing as desired and enjoy!
